reason: A DSH file-editing plugin that reads text with content-hash anchors, performs validated range replacements, and supports persistent undo for the latest replacement.

summaries.zh: 通过内容哈希锚点读取文本文件、校验并替换指定行范围，并支持撤销最近一次替换的 DSH 文件编辑工具。
summaries.en: A DSH file-editing tool that reads text with content-hash anchors, validates range replacements, and supports undoing the latest replacement.

capabilities: Read text files with hash-anchored line identifiers
Replace selected file line ranges after anchor validation
Undo the most recent replacement for a file
Persist hash, served-state, and undo metadata in a workspace state file
Perform atomic file writes through the DSH filesystem service
